dialogues.jp: 「暇だなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "I'm bored......"
dialogues.text: "I'm bored......"

dialogues.jp:
音夢に持ってきてもらったパジャマに身を包み、
純白のベッドに横たわる俺は、ひとり時間を持
て余していた。
dialogues.en:
I was lying on the white sheets and feeling bored. I was
wearing the pajamas that Nemu brought for me.
dialogues.text:
I was lying on the white sheets and feeling bored. I was
wearing the pajamas that Nemu brought for me.

dialogues.jp: 「なんか本でも買って来てもらえばよかったな」
dialogues.en: "I should've asked her to bring some books or something."
dialogues.text: "I should've asked her to bring some books or something."

dialogues.jp: 「静かだ……」
dialogues.en: "It's so quiet......"
dialogues.text: "It's so quiet......"

dialogues.jp:
個室には俺以外に人が居るはずもなく、病院だ
けに周囲はとても静かで……。
dialogues.en:
There's no one else in this private room, and it's so quiet
since this is a hospital......
dialogues.text:
There's no one else in this private room, and it's so quiet
since this is a hospital......

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、俺ひとりだけ置いてけぼりをくらっ
た気分だな。
dialogues.en: I felt like everyone had left me here all alone.
dialogues.text: I felt like everyone had left me here all alone.

dialogues.jp:
こうなると、定期的に来てくれる看護師さんが、
とても待ち遠しい。
dialogues.en:
I was looking forward to seeing the nurse who checked on me
every once in a while.
dialogues.text:
I was looking forward to seeing the nurse who checked on me
every once in a while.

dialogues.jp: 「白衣の天使とはよくいったものだ」
dialogues.en: "Nurses are like angels with white gowns......"
dialogues.text: "Nurses are like angels with white gowns......"

dialogues.jp:
看護師さんに憧れを抱くやつらの気持ちが、か
すかにだが分かる気がする。
dialogues.en:
I think I understand why people get the urge to touch a
nurse's behind when they're stuck in hospital.
dialogues.text:
I think I understand why people get the urge to touch a
nurse's behind when they're stuck in hospital.

dialogues.jp: 寂しいんだろう。
dialogues.en: They're probably feeling lonely.
dialogues.text: They're probably feeling lonely.

dialogues.jp: 「関係ないか」
dialogues.en: "It's none of my business."
dialogues.text: "It's none of my business."

dialogues.jp: さっきから、独り言ばっかりだな……。
dialogues.en: I've been talking to myself way too much......
dialogues.text: I've been talking to myself way too much......

dialogues.jp: そろそろ危ない気がする。
dialogues.en: I think I might be losing my mind.
dialogues.text: I think I might be losing my mind.

dialogues.jp: コンコン――
dialogues.en: Knock, knock......
dialogues.text: Knock, knock......

dialogues.jp: 天使降臨！？
dialogues.en: Is it my angel?
dialogues.text: Is it my angel?

dialogues.jp:
一瞬、そう思ったが、まだ定期検診の時間には
早すぎる。すでに検診の時間は把握していた。
dialogues.en:
I thought for a moment, but it's too early for the routine
check up. I know when they're supposed to come.
dialogues.text:
I thought for a moment, but it's too early for the routine
check up. I know when they're supposed to come.

dialogues.jp: ということは、見舞いの客か。
dialogues.en: Could it be someone else visiting me?
dialogues.text: Could it be someone else visiting me?

dialogues.jp: 「どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Come in."
dialogues.text: "Come in."

dialogues.jp: 扉が開いて女の子が入ってくる。
dialogues.en: The door opened, and a girl came inside.
dialogues.text: The door opened, and a girl came inside.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Hello, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hello, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
あえて言おう――クマさん模様の可愛らしいパ
ジャマを着た萌先輩が、にこやかに微笑みなが
ら、俺の目の前に立っている。
dialogues.en:
Let me tell you something...... Moe-sempai was standing
there smiling, wearing cute teddy bear print pajamas.
dialogues.text:
Let me tell you something...... Moe-sempai was standing
there smiling, wearing cute teddy bear print pajamas.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……お身体の具合はどうですか？」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... How are you feeling?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... How are you feeling?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっと……まあ大丈夫です」
dialogues.en: "Well...... I'm okay......"
dialogues.text: "Well...... I'm okay......"

dialogues.jp:
音夢のパジャマ姿で一応免疫があるとは言え、
やはり家族以外の女の子の姿は特別だ。
dialogues.en:
I'm used to seeing Nemu in her pajamas, but it's a different
feeling to see a girl who isn't in my family wearing
pajamas.
dialogues.text:
I'm used to seeing Nemu in her pajamas, but it's a different
feeling to see a girl who isn't in my family wearing
pajamas.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの……本当にすみませんでした。朝倉くん
　にケガをさせてしまって……ほんとにほんと
　にすみませんでした」
dialogues.en:
Her soft skin is hidden under that thin piece of
material......
dialogues.text:
Her soft skin is hidden under that thin piece of
material......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「別に萌先輩のせいじゃないですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Umm...... I'm so sorry. It's my fault you got hurt......
I'm terribly sorry......"
dialogues.text:
"Umm...... I'm so sorry. It's my fault you got hurt......
I'm terribly sorry......"

dialogues.jp:
諸悪の根源は、信号が変わる前に加速して走り
ぬけようとしたへたれドライバーだ。
dialogues.en: "It's not your fault, Moe-sempai."
dialogues.text: "It's not your fault, Moe-sempai."

dialogues.jp: 「先輩の検査入院って、いつまでなんですか？」
dialogues.en:
The driver of the car was speeding through the light before
it changed. He's at fault.
dialogues.text:
The driver of the car was speeding through the light before
it changed. He's at fault.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「問題がないようでしたら、明日には退院です」
dialogues.en: "When are they going to finish your physical exam?"
dialogues.text: "When are they going to finish your physical exam?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか」
dialogues.en: "If there's no problem, I'm getting out of here tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "If there's no problem, I'm getting out of here tomorrow."

dialogues.jp:
残念。もっと萌先輩のパジャマ姿を見たかった
んだけどな。
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「毎日、お見舞いに来ますね」
dialogues.en:
That's unfortunate. I wanted to see more of her in those
pajamas.
dialogues.text:
That's unfortunate. I wanted to see more of her in those
pajamas.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そんな無理しなくても……」
dialogues.en: "I'll come visit you every day."
dialogues.text: "I'll come visit you every day."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、大丈夫です。なんでも言ってください。
　朝倉くんのために、なんでもしますから」
dialogues.en: "You don't have to do that."
dialogues.text: "You don't have to do that."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en:
"No, I will. Please ask me anything. I'll do anything for
you, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text:
"No, I will. Please ask me anything. I'll do anything for
you, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: ――なんでも？

いろんなシーンが次々と頭に浮かび、脳内が煩
悩で満たされる。
dialogues.en: ...Did she just say anything?
dialogues.text: ...Did she just say anything?

dialogues.en:
I started imagining all kinds of scenes, and my brain was
filled with fantasies.
dialogues.text:
I started imagining all kinds of scenes, and my brain was
filled with fantasies.

dialogues.jp: 素晴らしい言葉だ。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの、今なにかして欲しいこととかはありま
　すか？」
dialogues.en: What a nice word.
dialogues.text: What a nice word.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、とくに――あっ、そうだ」
dialogues.en: "Umm, is there anything you want me to do for you now?"
dialogues.text: "Umm, is there anything you want me to do for you now?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Not really...... oh, that's right!"
dialogues.text: "Not really...... oh, that's right!"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「すみませんが、マンガを買って来てもらえま
　せんか？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp:
これで萌先輩が帰ったら、また、何もすること
のない退屈な時間を過ごすハメになる。
dialogues.en: "Will you please go and get me some manga?"
dialogues.text: "Will you please go and get me some manga?"

dialogues.jp:
「マンガの雑誌を２〜３冊、お願いします。も
　う、暇で暇で」
dialogues.en: I'll have nothing to do after she leaves the room.
dialogues.text: I'll have nothing to do after she leaves the room.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「わかりました。では、行ってきますね」
dialogues.en: "Okay. I'll go get them now."
dialogues.text: "Okay. I'll go get them now."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩はなんだか嬉しそうに微笑むと、張り切っ
て出て行った。
dialogues.en: She smiled joyfully and left the room.
dialogues.text: She smiled joyfully and left the room.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「お待たせしました、朝倉くん。マンガの雑誌
　を買ってきました」
dialogues.en: "I'm back, Asakura-kun. I got you some manga."
dialogues.text: "I'm back, Asakura-kun. I got you some manga."

dialogues.jp:
随分と時間がたったころ、萌先輩がノックをし
て病室に戻ってきた。
dialogues.en:
After a while, Moe-sempai knocked on the door and returned
to my room.
dialogues.text:
After a while, Moe-sempai knocked on the door and returned
to my room.

dialogues.jp:
「遅かったですね。もしかして、売店に売って
　なかったんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"It took you a long time. Were they sold out in the hospital
shop?"
dialogues.text:
"It took you a long time. Were they sold out in the hospital
shop?"

dialogues.jp: まさか、外まで買いに行ったのかな……。
dialogues.en: Perhaps, she went out of the hospital to get them......
dialogues.text: Perhaps, she went out of the hospital to get them......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いえ。ただ、あまり良さそうなものがなかっ
　たので、病院の前にあるお店まで買いにいっ
　ていたんです」
dialogues.en:
"No, but they didn't have any good ones in the shop, so I
went to the book store across from the hospital."
dialogues.text:
"No, but they didn't have any good ones in the shop, so I
went to the book store across from the hospital."

dialogues.jp: やっぱり……。
dialogues.en: I knew it.
dialogues.text: I knew it.

dialogues.jp: 「まさか、その格好のままで行ったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "You went out there in that outfit?"
dialogues.text: "You went out there in that outfit?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はい。朝倉くんを待たせてしまってはいけな
　いと思ったので。でも、結局選ぶのに時間が
　かかってしまいました」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I didn't want to make you wait too long. However, it
took me a while to pick them out."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I didn't want to make you wait too long. However, it
took me a while to pick them out."

dialogues.jp: ちょっと申し訳なさそうに言う萌先輩。
dialogues.en: Moe spoke with regret.
dialogues.text: Moe spoke with regret.

dialogues.jp:
「いえ、謝る必要はないですよ。ありがとうご
　ざいます」
dialogues.en: "You don't need to feel bad. Thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "You don't need to feel bad. Thank you very much."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩相手に、この程度のことで驚いてはいら
れない。
dialogues.en:
I can't be surprised with her actions. It's Moe-sempai after
all.
dialogues.text:
I can't be surprised with her actions. It's Moe-sempai after
all.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ。あの……どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "You're welcome. Umm...... here you go."
dialogues.text: "You're welcome. Umm...... here you go."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうも」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩から袋を受け取り、中身を確かめる。
dialogues.en: I got the bag from Moe and looked inside.
dialogues.text: I got the bag from Moe and looked inside.

dialogues.jp: 中から出てきたのは……。
dialogues.en: When I looked at the books she got......
dialogues.text: When I looked at the books she got......

dialogues.jp:
『コレコレ』
『ボムボム』
dialogues.en: "'Hussy''Bunny boy''Slut house'."
dialogues.text: "'Hussy''Bunny boy''Slut house'."

dialogues.jp:
表紙にいかにも元気そうな少年の絵が描かれた
雑誌にはそんなタイトルがつけられていた……。
dialogues.en:
The magazines she brought had titles like that, with sexy
girls and the word 'X-rated' on the cover.
dialogues.text:
The magazines she brought had titles like that, with sexy
girls and the word 'X-rated' on the cover.

dialogues.jp: 「あの……どうしてこれを？」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Why did you buy these?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Why did you buy these?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの……どんな本がいいか分からなかったの
　で、男の子が喜びそうなものを選んだんです」
dialogues.en:
"Well...... I didn't know what kind of books you wanted, so
I got something that I thought men would like."
dialogues.text:
"Well...... I didn't know what kind of books you wanted, so
I got something that I thought men would like."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……そうですか」
確かに、男の子が喜ぶ本だが……。
dialogues.en: They're indeed, something that men like......
dialogues.text: They're indeed, something that men like......

dialogues.jp: （弟さんが基準なんだろうな……）
dialogues.en: (But it's awkward to get these from a girl......)
dialogues.text: (But it's awkward to get these from a girl......)

dialogues.jp:
手の上の雑誌を眺めながら、買ってくるものを
指定するべきだったと激しく後悔するのだった。
dialogues.en:
As I stared at the magazines in my hands, I had feelings of
regret. I should've told her what to get.
dialogues.text:
As I stared at the magazines in my hands, I had feelings of
regret. I should've told her what to get.

dialogues.en: ◆Books◆
dialogues.text: ◆Books◆

dialogues.jp:
暇をしている俺の元に、萌先輩がやって来てく
れた。検査だけの萌先輩は、問題がなければ、
明日退院出来るらしい。
dialogues.en:
As I was stuck being bored, Moe-sempai came to visit me.
She's staying in the hospital for a physical exam, but she's
leaving tomorrow if there's no problem.
dialogues.text:
As I was stuck being bored, Moe-sempai came to visit me.
She's staying in the hospital for a physical exam, but she's
leaving tomorrow if there's no problem.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、萌先輩にマンガの雑誌を買ってきてくれ
るよう頼んだ。
dialogues.en: I asked her to get me some manga.
dialogues.text: I asked her to get me some manga.

dialogues.jp:
外の本屋まで行って、戻ってきた萌先輩。彼女
の手にあった雑誌は子供向けの雑誌だった……。
dialogues.en:
She went out to the book store and came back. The books she
brought me back will make my lower body uncomfortable......
dialogues.text:
She went out to the book store and came back. The books she
brought me back will make my lower body uncomfortable......
